provenance.source: Wuwa Personal Assistant v1.0.14 target-relative exploration decisions
provenance.notes: Project screening heuristic, not official or mathematically optimal investment advice. Before three tuned slots, consider a bounded +15 exploration checkpoint; full-level improvement probability and positive gain screen its potential, not its immediate payoff. With a selected baseline, generic grade thresholds and qualified flags never influence spending. Only future checkpoint EXP and new tuners are charged; past investment is excluded.
